cohort: 22,232 nulliparous women with singleton pregnancies who delivered between 2010 and 2015 at an Irish Tertiary Maternity Hospital
finding: Nulliparous women with private health care were more than twice as likely to have a pre-labor caesarean section and significantly more likely to have induction of labor compared to those with publicly funded care.
mod_finding: Women with private cover were significantly more likely to have an operative vaginal delivery, whether labor commenced spontaneously or was induced.
